study: Amodal object reconstruction with a fixed quartic shape proxy
comparison: Change only the surface used by matched continuous fitting and pose selection. A is the locked C_E_Qsize full-support output. B is the existing ordinary continuous first-face fit from OABC (plain_pair). C fits a quartic superellipsoid, then outputs its tight upright box in the fitted axes.
cohort: The sealed OABC cohort of 416 already exposed ordinary physical frames. Report Validation 288, recording extension 128, and the 224 frames with recordings separated from the original 96-frame development panel. Preserve the full denominator and platform weighting.
input: Replay the sealed Qwen window, dimensions, PCA and Qwen yaws, blind fit-tree region, fitting and audit returns. Reconstruct the same selection fold with the previous camera and fit-tree code. Verify exact point and fold parity against the sealed inputs. No inference, training, segmentation model, template library, or new dataset.
surface: In object axes let h=d_Q/2. The occupied proxy is sum_k ((x_k-c_k)/h_k)^4 <= 1. Each semi-axis tip is feasible, so its tight box on the fitted axes has extents d_Q. The exponent is fixed across objects for this test. Only the center is optimized for each of the same two poses.
fit: Use the existing OABC ordinary continuous center envelope, anchors, maximum of 128 fitting returns, 5^3 grid plus anchor, two Powell starts of 120 calls each, and the same absolute optical-depth first-entry loss capped at max(0.1 m, half the short horizontal side). A miss costs the cap. Only the intersection surface changes. Use the old rule of a positive enclosure entry. Compute convex quartic entry within the box interval. Optical rays are camera-origin proxies based on the projected LiDAR returns.
selection: Minimize the same capped first-entry loss on the separate reserved selection fold using each arm's own surface. Require at least five fitting and five selection returns, and retain the identical original two-anchor fallback otherwise. Compare B with its sealed prediction coordinates and selection costs. Keep independent audit returns out of all fitting and selection.
diagnostics: Report paired Acc@25, Acc@50, mIoU, rescue/harm, median center error and paired center changes across the full roster and the matched fitted subset. Report the subset whose fitted region has at least 80% of points inside the annotated box padded by 0.05 m as a descriptive postseal support diagnostic. Compare the two fitted centers at B's selected yaw as a postseal attribution. Report fit and audit optical-depth residual, hits and center shifts. Use recording bootstrap for full-roster deltas.
decision: Adopt neither the shape family nor reconstruction as a replacement based on a surface residual reduction alone. Require better full-box localization and center error versus the matched cuboid fit, improvement over the locked method, and later confirmation on new recordings before promotion. Stop this prototype if the endpoint does not support it. All truth access is confined to postseal evaluation.
